MILAAN · PROJECT INFORMATION

About & Contact

Milaan is an independent software project founded by Bilal Ahmed in Pakistan to help small sellers review payment evidence with greater clarity.

Draft for review. The founder and country details are confirmed by the operator. Support arrangements and the legal launch documents are still being prepared. Milaan is not yet a registered company and has no registered business office.

Why Milaan exists

Small online sellers often compare order records, payment screenshots and account statements by hand. Milaan brings those records into one workspace, highlights matches and conflicts, and preserves the seller's role in deciding what happens next.

How it helps

Import orders and statement CSV files, attach payment screenshots, review suggested SHIP, HOLD or REVIEW outcomes, and record your decisions. The public fictional demo and bilingual English/Roman Urdu seller guide are available without an account.

Who operates Milaan

Bilal Ahmed operates Milaan as an individual founder based in Pakistan. The project began as part of AiCON '26. No registered-company status, external certification or institutional endorsement is claimed.

Contact and support

A support email is not configured yet. A working private contact channel and support arrangements will be published when available. Do not use authentication sender addresses as support inboxes, and do not share credentials, customer details or financial records in public GitHub issues.

Launch status

The website, guide and demo are intended to remain publicly accessible. Public account registration will open only after real email verification succeeds and the operator approves activation. The Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions remain drafts awaiting legal review and completion of the stated gaps.

A clear boundary

Milaan is not a bank or payment processor. It compares the evidence you supply; it does not independently establish payment settlement, determine fraud or guarantee shipping decisions.
